test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following awards did Indian politician Ghulam Nabi Azad receive in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Bhushan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghulam Nabi Azad,** a veteran Congress leader and** former Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, **received the **Padma Bhushan Award in 2022**.
 
• **Ghulam Nabi Azad **is an Indian politician who served as the seventh chief minister of Jammu and Kashmir and as the Minister of Health and Family Welfare from 2005 to 2008.
 
• He was the Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha until February 2021.
 
• He was India's Parliamentary Affairs Minister in former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh's ministry till October 27, 2005, when he was named Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Padma Bhushan** is the Republic of India's third-highest civilian award, after the Bharat Ratna and Padma Vibhushan, and before the Padma Shri. The award, which was established on **January 2, 1954**, recognises "distinguished service of a high order...without difference of race, occupation, status, or sex."
 
• **The Padma Shri** often spelt Padma Shree, is the Republic of India's fourth-highest civilian award.
 
• **The Bharat Ratna** is the Republic of India's highest civilian honour. The award, which was established on **January 2, 1954**, is given in honour of "outstanding service/performance of the highest order," regardless of race, occupation, status, or sex.
 
• **After the Bharat Ratna, the Padma Vibhushan **is the Republic of India's second-highest civilian honour.
